newsitem.title: USA: Oneida to repurchase up to 500,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Oneida to repurchase up to 500,000 shares.

text.p: Oneida Ltd on Wednesday said its board of directors authorized the company to buy back up to 500,000 more shares of its outstanding common stock.
The new authorization follows Oneida's recently completed repurchase of 500,000 shares, at an average price of $18.80 each, the company said.

Oneida's chairman, William Matthews, said the new authorization would allow the company to repurchase the shares from time to time at prevailing market prices. Any shares reacquired will be reserved for future issuances that meet corporate purposes, he added.
Shares of Oneida Ltd, which makes tableware and industrial wire and cable, were up 1/4 at 22-7/8 early Wednesday afternoon..
